ops_start_v1.text: Dusty, Dustoff, Hatay Ops. Warden in contact east of Binnish. Cleared in.
ops_start_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

warden_contact_v1.text: [shouting] Dusty, Warden Three-One. Troops in contact. Militia five hundred metres east. Two wounded.
warden_contact_v1.speaker: warden_booker

ops_qrf_v1.text: Dusty, Ops. Reaper has a column leaving Taftanaz. Armour and a gun.
ops_qrf_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

ops_strike_v1.text: Venom One-One, Hatay Ops. Column on the Taftanaz road. Cleared hot.
ops_strike_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

warden_moving_v1.text: [breathing heavily] Dusty, Warden. Breaking contact. Moving west to the PZ. Cover us.
warden_moving_v1.speaker: warden_booker

warden_at_pz_v1.text: Dustoff, Warden. At the PZ. Eight pax, two litter. PZ is secure.
warden_at_pz_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dustoff_inbound_v1.text: Warden, Dustoff Three-One. Inbound from the west. One minute.
dustoff_inbound_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

dustoff_lifting_v1.text: Dustoff Three-One lifting. Eight aboard. Low level, westbound.
dustoff_lifting_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

ops_clear_v1.text: Dustoff, Hatay Ops. Copy clear. Surgical team on the pad.
ops_clear_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

dusty_check_in_v1.text: Warden, Dusty One-One, two Apaches. Three minutes. Hold on.
dusty_check_in_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

warden_cleared_hot_v1.text: [urgent] Dusty, Warden. Farm wall, five hundred east. Cleared hot. Danger close.
warden_cleared_hot_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dusty_launch_v1.text: [urgent] Dusty One-Two, missile launch south. Flares, break left.
dusty_launch_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

venom_bombs_v1.text: Venom One-One, bombs away. Thirty seconds.
venom_bombs_v1.speaker: venom_lindqvist

dusty_qrf_v1.text: Ops, Dusty. Copy the column. Taking the gun first.
dusty_qrf_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

venom_copy_v1.text: Venom One-One, cleared hot. Three minutes.
venom_copy_v1.speaker: venom_lindqvist

warden_manpads_v1.text: Dusty, Warden. Missile team, farm buildings north of the road.
warden_manpads_v1.speaker: warden_booker

ops_ambush_v1.text: Dusty, Ops. Reaper sees a missile tube, south of the road.
ops_ambush_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

dustoff_down_v1.text: Dustoff on the ground. Load them up.
dustoff_down_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

dusty_bda_v1.text: Venom, Dusty. Good hits on the column. Nothing moving.
dusty_bda_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_aa_dead_v1.text: Ops, Dusty. Gun's destroyed. Moving to the lead vehicle.
dusty_aa_dead_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_on_station_v1.text: Warden, Dusty. On station west of you. Tally the farm wall.
dusty_on_station_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_aa_fire_v1.text: Dusty One-Two, gun's firing. Drop behind the tree line.
dusty_aa_fire_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_qrf_hit_v1.text: Ops, Dusty. Lead vehicle's burning. Column's stopped.
dusty_qrf_hit_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

warden_vehicle_lost_v1.text: Dusty, Warden. Three-Two lost a truck. RPG from the orchard.
warden_vehicle_lost_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dustoff_check_in_v1.text: Warden, Dustoff Three-One. Holding west. Call me at the PZ.
dustoff_check_in_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

dusty_escort_v1.text: Dustoff, Dusty. On your left. Keep it low.
dusty_escort_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

warden_good_hits_v1.text: Dusty, Warden. Good hits. Fire's slackening.
warden_good_hits_v1.speaker: warden_booker

warden_qrf_close_v1.text: Dusty, Warden. Armour on the road, a click east. They're dismounting.
warden_qrf_close_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dusty_hit_v1.text: Dusty, taking fire. Still in the fight.
dusty_hit_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

warden_pz_late_v1.text: Dustoff, Warden. Nearly at the PZ. Come now.
warden_pz_late_v1.speaker: warden_booker

ops_qrf_timeout_v1.text: Dusty, Ops. Vehicles moving at Taftanaz. Expect a QRF.
ops_qrf_timeout_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

ops_status_v1.text: Warden, Hatay Ops. Say status. Can you move?
ops_status_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

warden_status_v1.text: Ops, Warden. Still pinned. Moving once the jets hit.
warden_status_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dusty_dustoff_down_v1.text: Ops, Dusty. Dustoff is down. Marking the site.
dusty_dustoff_down_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

ops_dustoff_down_v1.text: Dusty, Hatay Ops. Copy. CSAR is launching. Hold overhead.
ops_dustoff_down_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

ops_timeout_ok_v1.text: Dustoff, Hatay Ops. Copy Warden aboard. Surgical team standing by.
ops_timeout_ok_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

ops_timeout_fail_v1.text: Warden, Hatay Ops. Ground QRF is coming to you. Hold the PZ.
ops_timeout_fail_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

warden_dusty_down_v1.text: Ops, Warden. Apaches are down. We need the jets.
warden_dusty_down_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dusty_launch_v2.text: Dusty One-One, launch north. Flares, breaking right.
dusty_launch_v2.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_launch_v3.text: Dusty, missile in the air. Flares, flares.
dusty_launch_v3.speaker: dusty_brennan

dusty_hit_v2.text: Dusty One-Two, hit. Systems good. Staying.
dusty_hit_v2.speaker: dusty_brennan

warden_more_hits_v1.text: Warden. Another one down on the wall.
warden_more_hits_v1.speaker: warden_booker

dusty_qrf_more_v1.text: Dusty. Another one stopped on the road.
dusty_qrf_more_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan
